text:
Situation: Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC enoxaparin sodium injection is listed on FDA's shortage list as To Be Discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-10-20. Corvale East holds 18 days on hand at 18 units per day. Corvale General holds 15 days on hand at 10.5 units per day.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records the reason as discontinuation of manufacture for the U.S. market, not related to product safety or quality concerns. The BluePoint Laboratories product label names Nanjing King-Friend Biochemical Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (FEI 3010625707) as the registered plant for analysis, manufacture, and pack. FDA inspection records for that plant show VAI classifications in 2015, 2018, and most recently 2023-11-10.

Our position: Current inventory covers 15 to 18 days depending on site. No alternative manufacturer is on FDA's shortage list today. Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. product availability and manufacturing site are unconfirmed; its label names no plant we could place. The same applies to BE Pharmaceuticals Inc., Cardinal Health 107, LLC, Civica, Inc., and Gland Pharma Limited.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to verify Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. product availability and confirm its manufacturing site; requires P&T committee approval to add to formulary.
2. Buyer to verify BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. product availability and confirm its manufacturing site; requires P&T committee approval to add to formulary.
3. Buyer to verify Cardinal Health 107, LLC product availability and confirm its manufacturing site; requires P&T committee approval to add to formulary.
4. Buyer to verify Civica, Inc. product availability and confirm its manufacturing site; requires P&T committee approval to add to formulary.
5. Buyer to verify Gland Pharma Limited product availability and confirm its manufacturing site; requires P&T committee approval to add to formulary.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
